echo "=== nvidia-smi ===" && nvidia-smi && echo "=== tmux ls ===" && tmux ls 2>&1 && echo "=== swift/python 训练进程 ===" && ps aux | grep -E "(swift|sft|train)" | grep -v grep

echo "=== v4-vanilla-seed0 (cuda:0, 4358 samples) ===" 
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/tax_error_inject_agent/checkpoints/mini_vanilla_sft_v4_seed0/*/checkpoint-*/adapter_config.json 2>/dev/null || echo "NO_CHECKPOINT"

echo "=== v4-taxei-seed0 (cuda:1, 9029 samples) ==="
